acceptance: On a test PR, add then remove no-auto-merge; make pr-arm then arms without a new push.
A held PR still cannot arm or merge while the label is present (the hold check still fails then).
docs/agent/merge-authority.md describes the hold-release sequence that works.
description:
Problem. On #3960, #3950 and #3949 (2026-11-06), removing the no-auto-merge label left the earlier failed pr-hold suite behind a newer success. make pr-arm refuses a required check with a failed suite behind a newer success (docs/agent/merge-authority.md 'Stale failed check suites'). make pr-rerun re-runs the failed hold run, but that replays the original labelled event payload, so it fails again. A body edit and a close/reopen did not clear it. #3960 and #3950 had to merge develop to get a new head, which cost a full CI and oracle cycle each. #3949 cleared it by re-running the run started by the unlabeled event.

Change. Make lifting a hold not require a new head. Options: pr-hold reads the PR's current labels from the API instead of the event payload; pr-arm treats a hold suite superseded by a success from the unlabeled event as superseded; or make pr-rerun target the latest hold run. Pick one and update merge-authority.md.

Guardrails: work in a linked worktree (make worktree-create); never edit the primary clone; no explanatory comments (make comment-policy-check); changelog.d fragment if user-facing; re-read cited symbols before editing; never bypass a required check or relax a ruleset (owner-only).
